git add pricing_cache.py && git commit -F - <<'EOF'
Raise pricing cache TTL to 1h and drop stale-snapshot fallback

Bumps CACHE_TTL_SECONDS from 900 to 3600, so pricing entries are
refreshed hourly instead of every 15 minutes.

Also removes lookup(), which served the previous snapshot whenever the
feed arrived late. That fallback let callers read prices of unbounded
age, which is harder to reason about than a plain cache miss; it had no
callers in this repo, so removing it is a no-op here.
EOF
